LanguageData.Gun_M1918_BAR_RWP.description: The M1918 BAR (Browning Automatic Rifle) is a powerful automatic firearm developed during World War I. It features a high rate of fire and good range, making it effective for laying down suppressive fire or dealing with large groups of enemies. It uses .30-06 Springfield ammunition and requires two hands to operate effectively. Though slightly cumbersome, this classic weapon offers reliability and substantial stopping power on the battlefield.
